invariant: Every Java consumer passes a resolved RoundCorner diameter through Fashion to the same USymbolStack. A cluster uses root.element.<diagramStyle>.group.stack; an explicit stack leaf uses root.element.<diagramStyle>.stack.title; EntityImageEmptyPackage uses root.element.<diagramStyle>.package.title. DESCRIPTION maps to componentDiagram and CLASS maps to classDiagram. USymbolStack rounds the inset URectangle by that diameter, uses radius RoundCorner/2 for each outer-path arc, and takes a distinct six-segment straight-line branch when RoundCorner is zero.
causal_divergence: The initial implementation correctly ports the shared USymbolStack path geometry, but the independent checker disproved two consumer selectors. Rust's single class stack_round_corner helper resolves classDiagram.group.stack for both clusters and empty-package leaves. Java Cluster#getStyle uses group.stack only for a true cluster, while EntityImageEmptyPackage#getStyle always uses classDiagram.package.title before ClusterDecoration selects the stack painter; an explicit empty stack and a packageStyle-derived stack therefore both ignore stack-specific selectors. The DESCRIPTION cluster counterexample additionally contains a broader root RoundCorner propagation failure affecting its artifact leaf as well as the stack; that adjacent mechanism is accounted separately under deployment-generic-round-corner-propagation.
planned_change: Keep the verified USymbolStack geometry. Split CLASS corner resolution by Java image owner: layout_package_clusters resolves classDiagram.group.stack, while every layout_empty_packages record resolves classDiagram.package.title regardless of painted symbol kind or whether the symbol came from an explicit stack keyword or packageStyle. Retain DESCRIPTION leaf componentDiagram.stack.title and cluster componentDiagram.group.stack resolution, with generic inherited root propagation handled by the separately accounted deployment mechanism. Preserve the generic document scaler as the only dpi/scale transform.
